info.cls_ename: Bachelor's Program of International Business Administration in English

description.describe_ch: 本課程的目的是使學生能在科技管理的基礎應用，著重實務應用，使學生能由所學應用於實際問題的解決。
description.describe_eh: The purpose of this course is to enable students to apply basic science and technology management, focusing on practical applications, so that students can apply what they have learned to solve practical problems.

targets.describe_ch: 能分析競爭策略與科技策略
targets.describe_en: Able to analyze competitive strategies and technological strategies.

textBooks.tpb_book: Strategic Management of Technology and Innovation, Bruton & White, Cengage Learning ISBN 9780538481731
textBooks.tpb_book_en: Strategic Management of Technology and Innovation, Bruton & White, Cengage Learning ISBN 9780538481731

readings.tpc_book: Strategic Management of Technological Innovation, Melissa Schilling,  華泰 ISBN 978 -1-260-56579-9
readings.tpc_book_en: Strategic Management of Technological Innovation, Melissa Schilling,  Hwa Tai Publishing ISBN 978 -1-260-56579-9
